subject: Inert Robotic Limbs May Starve the Brain of Essential Muscle-Bone Signals
script: From Agewell Brief: Inert Robotic Limbs May Starve the Brain of Essential Muscle-Bone Signals. Synthetic prosthetics restore mechanical movement, but their lifeless carbon fiber and titanium cannot synthesize the endocrine factors that keep hippocampal neurons alive. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
